comment: S.S. Anne captain's room + departure: the captain's seasickness beat (pokered SSAnneCaptainsRoom script) - rub his back, he recovers and gives HM01 (Cut), and his closing line announces the ship setting sail; this script then sets ss_anne_cleared, the story flag Vermilion Gym's record consumes (data/gym_requirements.json kanto_gym_3_surge, whose source_basis names this chain and the captain's HM01). Lines are exact bank labels (group SSAnneCaptainsRoom) in source order; the bridge ref is TEXT_SSANNECAPTAINSROOM_CAPTAIN. The obtain-fanfare line (_SSAnneCaptainsRoomCaptainReceivedHM01Text) is not a say step - the give_item step IS the grant - and the bag-full branch line is host UI business. The ship's rival battle is a separate placement beat, not part of this script. Ends faded to black: the departure itself (the host removes the ship / returns the player to Vermilion dock).
